title: Transfer nominal mixing through channel coupling and paid moments
statement: For fixed independent relative coefficient errors<=delta, couple each common channel at the smaller intensity until separation. From common initial nu, P(separate byT)<=delta integral_0^T E_nom,nu q(Xt)dt. If both terminal second moments<=M2, coordinate mean difference<=2sqrt(M2 p_T). A COMPLETE CONDITIONAL theorem follows if the fixed realization has the accepted nominal gap AND uniformly perturbed nonexplosion/positive recurrence/unique mu, polynomial-W stationary moments of fixed order s>=max(2,D), and matching uniform-time moments for nominal/perturbed evolution fromx0 AND nominal evolution from each perturbed mu. Start nominal atmu: TV(mu,pi)<=TV(mu P_T,pi)+delta integral E_nom,mu q. Truncate only the INITIAL comparison law at a polynomial proof radius; moments pay its tail and conditional Poisson lower atom weights plus the nominal gap give polynomial-time mixing inside. Moment-controlled separation and Cauchy-Schwarz then pay stationary/transient TV and ABSOLUTE means; order-D moments pay all firings. This does not derive the general recurrence/moment hypotheses or require a perturbed spectral gap.

No novelty, physical device advantage or independent validation is claimed; all held/unread sources and transfer limits persist.
